rule: CORE transplants by default. OPTIONAL copies only with --extra after sabotage fixtures exist. CANDIDATE needs a named incident then rebuild, never dump. IDENTITY never copies (target writes its own). NEVER never enters a factory install.
decision: Do not merge Pokemon + Career + Bonkers + thebus into one mega-repo. Transplant CORE. Load OPTIONAL by extra. Keep domain packs in their origin repos.
